document_title: The Every-day Life of Abraham Lincoln: A Narrative And Descriptive Biography With Pen-Pictures And Personal; Recollections By Those Who Knew Him
author: Francis F. Browne
claims: President Lincoln and Mrs. Lincoln decided to attend Ford's Theatre to see the play "The American Cousin".
The Presidential party arrived at the theatre at nine o'clock.
The theatre was crowded with ladies, officers, citizens, and young people, filled with a sense of victory and exhilaration.
At half past ten o'clock, during the play, a pistol shot was heard.
A man appeared at the President's box holding a smoking pistol and a dagger, then sprang to the stage shouting "Sic semper tyrannis!".
The President was carried from the theatre to a house across the street and laid on his deathbed.
President Lincoln died a little after seven o'clock in the morning on Saturday, April 15th.
